欽定本 - purge 2; 2

record.edic_text:
2508 kathairo {kath-ah'-ee-ro}

from 2513; TDNT - 3:413,381; v

AV - purge 2; 2

1) to cleanse, of filth impurity, etc
   1a) to prune trees and vines from useless shoots
   1b) metaph. from guilt, to expiate

same.cexp: 不純潔，不道德；不良的動機；污穢，腐爛
潔淨，使純潔；宣佈在禮儀上為可悅納的
潔淨的，乾淨的；純潔的，無罪的
